skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand international tax law and its application in cross-border transactions.
Analyze the impact of international trade on taxation policies.
Identify and resolve issues related to double taxation in international contexts.
Evaluate transfer pricing strategies and their implications on international taxation.
Apply competition law principles to international taxation scenarios.
Understand and apply anti-dumping duties in international trade.
Manage taxes for foreign contractors operating internationally.
Analyze Vietnamese international taxation laws and regulations in the context of regional and global integration.
